title: Overwhelm Journaling Prompts: 10 Guided Reflections to Regain Control
summary: Feeling overwhelmed? These 10 guided journaling prompts help you calm your mind, break the spiral, and shift from chaos to clarity.
body_markdown:
Overwhelm isn’t always about having too much to do — sometimes, it’s about feeling like you have no control over where to start, or like everything matters *too much* at once.


These 10 journaling prompts, written by[Jon Filitti](https://www.getstoic.com/authors/jon-filitti) **(Licensed Mental Health Counselor)** , are designed to help you slow down, sort through the chaos, and find a way forward—step by step.


These prompts are also part of the **Stoic app’s Emotion Check-In** , where you can explore and write through your emotions in real time.
